blends.desc: Ahoy there fellow Degen. Do you happen to have a card with three matching POTD symbols? Well that's a yuge win Matey!!!!! Simply blend it here to receive your 50,000,000 $WUF! Then you just have to choose to hold the $WUF, or scratch some more. Whatever you shall choose Im glad you chose it with the Degen Pirates and Wuffi!!!

blends.name: Scratch-2-Win match 3 Poo Winner Blend

blends.name: The Final Blend To the Airdrops
blends.desc: CONGRATULATIONS MATEY!!!!! You have reached the ultimate Vessel currently known to the Pirates of the Degen as Diablo de Agua. This ship has burned countless Degen Ships until finally captured by you. Great job savaging through the rough seas and fighting your way to the top of the Degens. As long as this Sea Devil is under your control you will be magically granted WAX each day. The larger the POTD grows the greater the bounties so continue on and enjoy your time as a Degen Pirate.

blends.name: 3 Commons For New Clip pack
blends.desc: So you have some common clips laying around. As great as each one is a true Degen needs a higher boost. Sacrifice three common clips to receive a new chance at a higher boosting rarity. However you could end with another common as well. Its a Degen move for sure but could pan out for ya Matey.

blends.name: Brigantine to Galleon Blend
blends.desc: The journey has been hard but you are one step closer. I see you have 3 Brigantines and your ready to level up. Well hand them on over and well get you a Ship worthy of any Degen Crew sailing these Waxy NFseas, the Galleon. This ship can use all boosters but there's one out there even more grand. Get yourself two Galleons and be rewarded as one of the top Degen Pirate members.

blends.name: Sloop to Brigantine Blend
blends.desc: Congratulations Matey on aquiring a brigade of Sloops. However on your journey to the almighty Booty Ship one must blend 4 sloops to receive there Brigantine. Enjoy your new ship and good luck on your Degen Journeys My Friend.

blends.name: Build A Ship
blends.desc: Welcome to our Build A Ship Blend. Once you have acquired the necessary parts blend them here to receive a Degen Ship Pack. While most will reveal a Sloop in there pack, some lucky pirates will receive a rare Brigantine or the luckiest will skip ahead to a Legendary Galleon! Good luck Matey and enjoy your Degen Pirate Journey.
